FULL SERVICE FOR OUR COMMUNITIES
Throughout all our locations, we serve farms and ranches, commercial businesses and residential customers alike. We're proud to offer premier agricultural products from Cenex Petroleum at our Car Care Centers, and we represent national brands like Ace Hardware, NAPA Auto Parts and Ampride convenience stores.

Hello and welcome to our new website! We realize this change to a new webpage may be difficult but we hope you will be patient with us as we move forward. This webpage showcases many members of our team and also members of our community working hard for the American dream.
Agriculture represents the backbone of America, but it also represents some of the most cutting-edge technology and advancements in daily life. It is our hope this website serves as a useful tool to everyone who visits it.
